text:
Jordan: Morning team — quick async standup for gateway QoS / auth / rate.
Jordan: What I did: merged `batching-fix` into edge-proxy, ran a staging smoke, validated token-bucket window math.
Jordan: Blockers: intermittent 429s during small bursts on canary (canary-2) when concurrency spikes.
Jordan: Today: finish canary rollback test + review Priya's authz CR. If you own /v1/embed or /v1/gen please ack.

Priya: Saw the 429s earlier. Logs point to refill bursts caused by `refill_ms` rounding. Pushing a conservative patch to staging now.
Priya: Ping @Samir for CR review.

Dmitri: I reproduced this locally with a small loadshot. Steps: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d30s http://staging/gw/v1/gen`. Token-bucket misbehaves when concurrency > 100.
Dmitri: Suspect race in refill loop around integer division + rounding.

Jordan: Can you paste the failing config snippet?

Dmitri: ```yaml
token_bucket:
  capacity: 1000
  refill_amount: 50
  refill_ms: 1000
```
Dmitri: The bug shows when `refill_ms` ends up being computed to 0 in some code paths.

Samir: I'll take the CR after lunch and run the load repro on my side. Quick FYI — dedicated pools' coldstarts are spiking latency which could make windows look worse; tracking separately. cc Jen.

Jen: Reminder — JWT rotation for edge certs scheduled at 14:00 PT today. Pause long-polling tests 13:45-14:15 if you have them. Details: https://redwood-internal/runs/jwt-rotation

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline "staging-token-fix" succeeded (build 8842) :rocket: 

Priya: Rolling patch into canary-2 now, will watch logs for 10m.

Jordan: Thanks. If canary looks good we'll roll to full staging by EOD. Adding a tiny CI smoke: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://staging/gw/health` -> expect 200.

Dmitri: Added a unit test + opened issue #4712 for the race: https://redwood-internal/issue/4712

Samir: :thumbsup: will merge after the tests pass.

Jordan: Overall good progress despite the hiccup. I'll post a short follow-up if we need a rollback. @channel please ack if you touched any routing policy configs or rate rules today.
